Name: Skull
Description: Create base structure for head rig

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Create base structure for head rig. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. CtrlType: choose one option (for example: cube, square, circleX, circleY). CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: lightBlue, blue, white, purple). Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl, Spine_End_Jnt. Template attrs-position examples: Nose_Base_Ctrl, Vis_Ctrl, L_Brow_Ctrl.
